lessons.title: Hello, nice to meet you
lessons.goal: Introduce yourself and ask someone their name.

activities.prompt: Listen, then write the sentence you hear.
activities.text: Hello, my name is Mai. Nice to meet you.
answers: Hello, my name is Mai. Nice to meet you.
activities.explanation: Use “My name is…” to introduce yourself.

activities.prompt: Listen to the model, then record yourself saying the same sentence.
activities.text: Good morning. How are you today?
answers: Good morning. How are you today?
activities.explanation: Try saying “How are you” as one natural phrase.

activities.prompt: Arrange the words to introduce yourself.
activities.explanation: Use this order: My name + is + your name.

activities.prompt: Fill in the missing word: Nice to ___ you.
activities.explanation: “Nice to meet you” is a greeting when you meet someone for the first time.

activities.prompt: Correct this sentence: She are my friend.
activities.explanation: Use “is” with he, she, and it.

activities.prompt: What is the name of Mai’s friend? Write the name.
activities.text: Hello! My name is Mai. I live in Hanoi. This is my friend Tom. We are students. We like playing chess after school.
activities.explanation: The passage says, “This is my friend Tom.”

activities.prompt: Read this introduction aloud. Then compare your recording with the model.
activities.text: My name is Mai. I live in Hanoi. I like playing chess.
answers: My name is Mai. I live in Hanoi. I like playing chess.
activities.explanation: Pause briefly at the end of each sentence.

lessons.title: My family, my home
lessons.goal: Talk about your family and where you live.

activities.text: I live with my parents and my sister.
answers: I live with my parents and my sister.
activities.explanation: “Live with” tells us who shares your home.

activities.text: There are four people in my family.
answers: There are four people in my family.
activities.explanation: Use “There are” when talking about more than one person.

activities.prompt: Correct this sentence: He live in a small house.
answers: He lives in a small house
activities.explanation: Add -s to the verb with he, she, and it in the present simple.

activities.prompt: How many sisters does Linh have? Write a number or word.
activities.text: My name is Linh. There are four people in my family: my parents, my sister, and me. My sister is younger than me. We live in a small house.
This is my family. We live in a small house.
answers: This is my family. We live in a small house.
activities.explanation: Keep the words connected within each sentence.
